summary: Turkey filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a benchmark USD-denominated sovereign note offering under an existing shelf. Pricing, coupon, maturity, principal amount, and underwriter discount are left blank in this preliminary version; proceeds go to the Republic before expenses, and the notes are direct, general, unconditional obligations backed by full faith and credit. Notes carry collective action clauses with 75%/66.67% modification thresholds and will be listed on the LSE's ISM, settling via DTC. This is routine sovereign debt issuance, not a corporate special situation; watch final pricing, coupon, tenor, and book size.
